services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: Welcome to Port Royale Marina. Nestled in Georgia’s Blue Ridge Mountains, Port Royale is Lake Lanier’s premier marina destination, offering everything from daily pontoon and ski boat rentals to slips for harboring your boat. Incredible lake views, fantastic dining and world-class marina services await you less than an hour out of Atlanta - let’s set sail. Welcome to the Neighborhood. We’re boaters too, which is why we know how important it is to choose the right home for your boat. That’s why we’ve built brand new, modern docks that’ll keep your baby safe while you’re ashore. Plus, your slip membership will get you access to exclusive events, member’s parties, and top of the line amenities

services.name: Sunset Grille

Boasting the best boat storage on Lake Allatoona including brand new covered & uncovered wet slips, the largest Dry Stack operation on Lake Allatoona, and fantastic dining at Sunset Grille, Victoria Harbour is a boater’s dream. Gorgeous sunsets, 360 degree lake views, and world-class marina services conveniently await you only 45 minutes from Atlanta.
